sentences.text: Ardi shkon në shkollë me gjyshin.
sentences.english: Ardi goes to school with his grandfather.

sentences.text: Rruga e shkollës është e gjatë.
sentences.english: The road to the school is long.

sentences.text: Ardi ka një çantë të madhe.
Në çantë ka libra dhe bukë.
sentences.english: In the bag there are books and bread.

sentences.text: Ai është i lumtur, sepse sot ka shkollë.
sentences.english: He is happy, because today there is school.
Then the grandfather goes to the market.

sentences.text: Në treg ai pi kafe me Samin.
sentences.english: At the market he drinks coffee with Sam.
